ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image there are four route diagrams on the same grid paper, respectively labeled A, B, C, D; each route connects two black dots. Below there is also option E, with the text “All routes are equal”. These routes are all composed of 45° diagonal line segments along the grid. Reasoning: The length of each diagonal line segment crossing one small square is the same, so to compare the route lengths, one only needs to count how many identical unit diagonal line segments each route contains. A has 4 segments from the left end to the vertex, and then 4 segments to the right end, for a total of 8 segments. Although B folds up and down in the middle, it also has 8 segments in total. C is composed of four shorter broken-line segments, totaling 8 unit diagonal line segments. D is a denser zigzag shape, and also has exactly 8 unit diagonal line segments. Therefore the route lengths of A, B, C, D are equal, and the shortest route is not one individual label, but “all routes are equal”.

raw_record.question_text: What is the label of the shortest route between the two points?

method.method_draft: Inspect the image: there are four route diagrams labeled A, B, C, and D on identical square grids, plus option E reading “All routes are equal.” For each route, count the number of equal diagonal grid-step segments between the two black endpoint dots. Route A has 8 unit diagonal steps; B splits into up/down diagonal pieces but still totals 8 unit diagonal steps; C also totals 8; D is a tighter zigzag with 8 unit diagonal steps. Since every step is the same 45-degree diagonal across one grid square, all four route lengths are equal, so the shortest-route label is E.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有四个在相同方格纸上的路线图，分别标为 A、B、C、D；每条路线都连接两个黑点。下方还有选项 E，文字为“All routes are equal”。这些路线都是沿方格的 45° 对角线段组成。

推理：每一个跨过一个小方格的对角线段长度相同，所以比较路线长度只需要数每条路线包含多少个相同的单位对角线段。A 从左端到顶点有 4 段，再到右端有 4 段，共 8 段。B 虽然中间上下折返，但总共也是 8 段。C 由四段较短折线组成，共 8 个单位对角线段。D 是更密的锯齿形，也正好有 8 个单位对角线段。因此 A、B、C、D 的路线长度相等，最短路线并非某一个单独标签，而是“所有路线相等”。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the labels A-D, the black endpoint dots, the square grid, the diagonal segment paths, and the visible option E “All routes are equal.” Count the unit diagonal grid steps in each route.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know that the requested output is the label of the shortest route between the two points.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule that diagonal moves across congruent grid squares have equal length, so total route length is proportional to the number of such diagonal unit steps.
